prompt: Arrange the constant-space steps that compare every pair.

steps.text: For each index i from 0 through n - 2, choose nums[i] as the left value.
For each index j from i + 1 through n - 1, compare nums[i] with nums[j].
If nums[i] equals nums[j], return true immediately.
After both loops finish without a match, return false.

explanation: The inner loop starts after i, so every distinct pair is compared once. A match returns true early; false is safe only after every pair has been checked. The algorithm uses only the two index variables, so its extra space is O(1).
